messages:
sam_support: FYI — customer reports no welcome credits after signup via GitHub SSO + payment on Chrome mobile (Google Pay). They verified email and completed the payment sheet but credits never applied. account_id: acct_01FXXXX, signup_ts: 1963456700. Payment token: pay_tok_84ef.

violet_payments: I pulled the payments logs. The instrument token was accepted but our fraud service flagged `device_region_mismatch` and set `fraud_status=manual_review` before trial grant step. snippet: `fraud_check(device_ip=45.129.2.11, geo=DE, billing_country=US) -> manual_review`

sam_support: The customer says they were on a work VPN (switched to AU earlier) and then signed up from a US billing address. They have a verified @examplecorp.com email. They were pretty insistent they completed everything.

ton y_security: small typo in my name ;) I looked at the risk rules: we have a rule that blocks auto-trial when IP country != billing country && payment_sheet_used=true. This is to avoid cross-border fraud but it's catching legitimate VPN/remote work signups.

violet_payments: Can we see the full payment flow? I can see `payment_intent -> succeeded`, but our backend stops before `apply_welcome_credit` because of `manual_review`. Repro steps I used: 1) GitHub SSO -> 2) open Chrome Android -> 3) open GPay sheet -> 4) send token -> backend returns `manual_review` for that combo.

sam_support: Customer provided device info: Pixel 6, Chrome 118, OS locale PL, public IP geo DE, billing country US. Also attached screenshot of successful charge confirmation from Google Pay.

ton y_security: Proposal: change rule to only block auto-trial when `manual_review && payment_declined` or if 2+ risk signals present. Otherwise we should queue for human review but still allow welcome credit if email verified + low-risk domain. Thoughts?

maria_cx: For this customer we should manually grant credits to unblock their trial. I'll do manual grant and note it in the account. Also we should follow up with the product change.

violet_payments: If you need the payment token to re-evaluate we can run a recheck with relaxed thresholds. I can run `recheck_payment(pay_tok_84ef, relax_rules=true)` and return the verdict.

maria_cx: Doing manual grant now. Granting 100 USD equivalent credits to acct_01FXXXX.

ops-bot: action:manual_grant completed by maria_cx on acct_01FXXXX amount:100 reason:"customer_suspected_vpn_region_mismatch"

sam_support: Marking customer updated and credits visible. Closing the support thread once we confirm they can use tokens.

ton y_security: Filed follow-up ticket in infra (TKT-1729) to change rule logic and add allowlist for verified company domains for a 24h grace.

maria_cx: Follow-up: I emailed the customer explaining the manual grant and asking them to reach out if they hit any gating again. Closing from CX side. :white_check_mark:
